The company operates through four segments: Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury, and Other Banking Operations. DEEPA.NS.d: Deepa Jewellers Limited designs, processes and supplies hallmarked gold jewellery in India. Its traditional pieces include waist belts, CNC-cut bangles, kada, armlets, necklaces, earrings, forehead pendants, hair ornaments and rings, sold via the Internet. Incorporated in 2016, it is based in Hyderabad.

DMCC.NS.d: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited and its affiliates make and supply specialty and commodity chemicals in India and overseas. The range includes sulphur-based and boron-based compounds, functional chemicals and life science substances, used in agriculture, construction, personal care, dyes and pigments, electroplating and many other industrial processes.

GLOBALVECT.NS.d: Global Vectra Helicorp Limited provides helicopter charter services for offshore and onshore transportation in the oil and gas exploration and production sector in India. It also offers its services to religious tourism, geophysical survey, corporate and VVIP flying, election flying, remote location freight, emergency services, underslung operations, and aerial photography and filming, as well as powerline inspection, construction, and maintenance.

GOKULAGRO.NS.d: Gokul Agro Resources Limited manufactures and trades in edible and non-edible oils, meals, and other agro products in India, the United States, South Korea, European Union, China, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Russia, and Vietnam. The company offers soya bean oil, cottonseed oil, palm oil, sunflower oil, groundnut oil, vanaspati, etc.; and other industrial products, such as castor oil of various grades and its derivatives.

GULFPETRO.NS.d: GP Petroleums Limited engages in formulating, manufacturing, and marketing industrial and automotive lubricants, process oils, transformer oils, greases, and other specialties in India and internationally. It offers automotive lubricants, including automotive engine oils, gear and transmission oils, greases, engine coolant and brake fluids, and diesel exhaust fluids.

HPL.NS.d: HPL Electric & Power Limited manufactures and sells electric equipment under the HPL brand in India. The company operates through four segments: Metering, Switchgear, Lighting & Electronics, and Cables.

JUBLPHARMA.NS.d: Jubilant Pharmova Limited operates as an integrated pharmaceutical company worldwide. It operates through three segments: Pharmaceuticals; Drug Discovery & Development Solutions; and Proprietary Novel Drugs.

JYOTHYLAB.NS.d: Jyothy Labs Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets detergents, soaps, and mosquito repellents in India and internationally. It operates through Dishwashing, Fabric Care, Household Insecticides, Personal Care, Laundry Services, and Others segments. The Dishwashing segment offers dish wash scrubbers and scrubber steel, as well as dish wash bars, liquids, and powders under the Pril and Exo brands.

KRISHANA.NS.d: Krishana Phoschem Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers, intermediate dyes, and other allied chemical products in India. The company offers benefited rock phosphate, single super phosphate (SSP), granulated single super phosphate (GSSP), H-acid, intermediate dyes, sulphuric acid, chloro sulphonic acid, liquid SO3, and other allied chemicals. The company's SSP and GSSP products are used as fertilizer for crop. It also engages in the contract manufacturing of chemicals.

LINC.NS.d: Linc Limited makes and sells writing instruments and stationery in India and worldwide, mainly under the Linc brand. Its pens include fountain, retractable, rollerball, ballpoint and gel types, and it also offers markers, highlighters and other stationery.

MAGMA.NS.d: Magma Fincorp Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides asset finance services in India. The company offers loans for cars, SMEs, construction equipment, commercial vehicles, tractors, and used vehicles. It also provides housing finance; and auto leasing services. The company operates a network of 314 branches. Magma Fincorp Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

MAHASTEEL.NS.d: Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited manufactures and sells structural steel products in India. It offers joists, H-beams, channels, angles, billets/blooms, rounds, flats, railway sleepers, etc. The company was formerly known as Rajesh Strips Limited and changed its name to Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited in 2009. Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited was founded in 1988 and is based in Raipur, India.

NECLIFE.NS.d: Nectar Lifesciences Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company offers contract research and manufacturing services, including process development and optimization, process scale up and validation, preparation and international submission of drug master files and certificates of suitability, multi kilo pilot plant production, bulk production, and chiral resolution; and chemical and analytical development, as well as analytical, manufacturing, and engineering…

OCCLLTD.NS.d: OCCL Limited, headquartered in Noida and established in 1978, produces and supplies insoluble sulfur in the Indian market. It also supplies oleums and sulfuric acid of commercial and battery grades, used in industry as dehydrating agents, catalysts, solvents and absorbents, and sells internationally.

PEARLPOLY.NS.d: Pearl Polymers Limited manufactures and sells rigid packaging and houseware products in India and internationally. It offers PET bottles and jars for kitchen, home, and office use; containers; and copper bottles. The company sells its products under the Procasa brand name. It offers its products online. Pearl Polymers Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

PKTEA.NS.d: The Peria Karamalai Tea and Produce Company Limited engages in the production and distribution of tea in India. The company operates through Tea, Investment, and Power segments. Its plantations cover approximately 6,000 acres of land located in the Anamalai Hills, Coimbatore District in Tamil Nadu. The company also generates and distributes power through solar and wind energy. In addition, it invests in financial instruments. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.

POCL.NS.d: Pondy Oxides And Chemicals Limited (POCL), set up in 1995, with its head office in Chennai, is mainly a secondary lead smelter. It makes and distributes lead metals and alloys, zinc metal and zinc oxides in India, and also sells master, tin and babbit alloys and additives for PVC.

PRAJIND.NS.d: Praj Industries Limited operates in the field of bio-based technologies and engineering worldwide. It offers solutions for the ethanol industry, including multi-feed multi-product plants, modernization of existing plants, and renewable fuels comprising BioCNG, iso-butanol etc.; produces bio ethanol, bio butanol, bio chemicals, power, bio CNG, CO2, etc.; and operates bio-mobility platform that promotes the use of renewable resources to produce carbon neutral transportation fuel.

RAJOOENG.NS.d: Rajoo Engineers Ltd., set up in 1986, with its head office in Rajkot, India, makes and distributes equipment for plastic processing and post-extrusion worldwide. Its machinery includes downward extrusion blown film lines, either mono or co-extruded in three, five, seven or nine layers.

RATEGAIN.NS.d: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited, an India-based software-as-a-service provider founded in Noida in 2004, supplies technology to the global hospitality and travel industries across India, North America, Asia-Pacific and Europe. Products include AirGain for airfare pricing intelligence, CarGain for car rental analysis, FerryGain for ferry revenue management, Optima for real-time rate intelligence, and PriceGain and Rate Parity tools.

RITES.NS.d: RITES Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides consultancy, engineering, and project management services in the field of railways, highways, airports, ports, ropeways, urban transport, inland waterways, and renewable energy. It operates through four segments: Consultancy Services; Leasing of Railway Rolling Stock & Equipments; Export of Rolling Stock, Equipments and spares; and Turnkey Construction Projects.

SHAHALLOYS.NS.d: Shah Alloys Limited manufactures and sells flat and long stainless steel, alloy and special steel, carbon/mild steel, and armor steel products in India. It offers hot rolled coils, hot rolled sheets/plates, cold rolled coils and sheets, hot rolled round bars, bright round bars, peeled bars, and hot rolled flat bars, as well as angles, beams, flats, slabs, billets, etc. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries. Shah Alloys Limited was founded in 1990 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

SUNRAKSHAK.NS.d: Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SUNRAKSHAK and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TCI.NS.d: Transport Corporation of India Limited provides end to end integrated supply chain and logistics solutions in India. It operates through Freight, Supply Chain Solutions, Seaways, and Energy divisions. The company offers integrated surface transport solutions, such as truck load, packages and consignments, over dimensional cargo, and project heavy haul and rail.

TCIFINANCE.NS.d: TCI Finance Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company offers loans against securities, commercial vehicle finance, global IP convention, IP valuation, and other financial services, as well as patents, trademark, and copyright services. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

TIJARIA.NS.d: Tijaria Polypipes Limited manufactures and sells pipes, sprinkle systems, conduit pipes, etc. under the Tijaria and Vikas brand names in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Pipes and Textiles.

WOCKPHARMA.NS.d: Wockhardt Limited, a pharmaceutical and biotechnology company, manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients, formulations, bio-similars, and vaccines in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It provides pharmaceutical products in the therapeutic areas of anti-infective, cardiology, dermatology, diabetology, neurology, pain management, respiratory, and other areas.
